Cookies.

The current Low Value Content showcase does not intentionally set cookies or use analytics, advertising, personalization, or tracking technologies.

Current state

The site is static and its code does not set browser cookies or local-storage identifiers. External social sites may use their own technologies after a visitor follows a link to them.

Future state

If measurement, email, personalization, or commerce tools are added, this page and any required consent controls must be updated before those tools are enabled. Necessary and optional technologies will be described separately.

Browser controls

Visitors can review or delete stored site data through their browser settings. At present, there should be no Low Value Content cookie preference to manage.
